---
title: "Accessibility"
toc: false
---

I want this website to be usable by as many people as possible,
including people who use assistive technologies.

As I build and update the site, I aim to provide:

- Readable text and sufficient color contrast in light and dark modes.
- Navigation and interactive elements that work with a keyboard.
- Descriptive links and a clear heading structure.
- Useful alternative text for meaningful images.
- Research figures and technical content with supporting explanations.

## Ongoing improvements

This website is a personal project and is still evolving.
Some pages, figures, or interactive features may have accessibility
limitations.

I have not completed a comprehensive accessibility evaluation and
do not currently claim conformance with a specific accessibility standard.

## Report a problem

If you encounter a barrier while using this website, please open an issue on this website's [Github](https://github.com/DKutzen22/kutzen.org/issues/new)

If possible, include:

- The page where you encountered the problem.
- What you were trying to do.
- A description of what did not work.
- Your browser or assistive technology, if relevant.

I’ll use this feedback to prioritize improvements.
